description: Overrides master read/write access permissions in Flash Descriptor to 0xFFFFFFFF for full SPI unlock.
author: R1 LAB

title: Universal ME Manufacturing Mode Clear
symptom: System warns: Manufacturing Mode 0x33 or ME in Manufacturing Mode on boot.
description: Clears the Manufacturing Mode flag in the Intel Flash Descriptor to normal production mode.
author: R1 LAB

title: Universal TPM & Intel PTT Security Flag Clean
symptom: TPM device malfunction or BitLocker PCR measurement mismatch on startup.
description: Clears Intel Platform Trust Technology (PTT) state cache in UEFI NVRAM.
author: R1 LAB
